description: Everything the public record says about a UK company, joined and read. Registry facts, distress signals, directors' and PSCs' ID verification against the deadline, and (for large companies) the payment-practices record, with the three things most worth knowing first. Also public contracts won, the gender pay gap, Environment Agency registrations and a UK Sanctions List check. 3 credits. One call that joins several of the other tools for a first look; for one register in full use its own tool (accounts, charges, ownership, registers, contracts_won).

company.description: A company number, or a name (resolved to one company, named in the reply)
